oneLiner: Convert raw status notes into polished updates tailored for executives and the broader team.
problem: Teams waste time reformatting status bullets and struggle to craft messages that suit different audiences, leading to inconsistent communication and missed insights.
targetUser: Mid-level managers and project leads who compile weekly status reports for both leadership and their own teams.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Home view with list of past briefs and a button to create a new update.

screens.name: Input Screen
screens.purpose: Textarea or file upload where users paste raw status bullets.

screens.name: Audience Selection
screens.purpose: Modal allowing selection of Exec or Team version and customization of tone, length, and detail.

screens.name: Draft Review
screens.purpose: Display the generated updates side‑by‑side with inline editing capabilities.

screens.name: Export & Share
screens.purpose: Provide options to copy, download as PDF/Word, email, or push to collaboration tools.
